## Eight-chapter learning path

Each chapter develops one layer of statistical reasoning and connects directly to a guided laboratory.

::: {.statx-directory}
<a class="statx-directory-card" href="chapter-01/"><span>CHAPTER 01 · AVAILABLE</span><h3>Mathematical Foundations</h3><p>Fractions, percentages, exponents, algebra, functions, graphs, and introductory probability.</p><b>START CHAPTER →</b></a>

<a class="statx-directory-card" href="chapter-02/"><span>CHAPTER 02</span><h3>Introduction to Statistics</h3><p>Data types, populations and samples, descriptive statistics, and visualization.</p><b>OPEN CHAPTER →</b></a>

<a class="statx-directory-card" href="chapter-03/"><span>CHAPTER 03</span><h3>Probability Basics</h3><p>Probability rules, conditional probability, Bayes’ theorem, random variables, and distributions.</p><b>OPEN CHAPTER →</b></a>

<a class="statx-directory-card" href="chapter-04/"><span>CHAPTER 04</span><h3>Statistical Inference</h3><p>Sampling distributions, the Central Limit Theorem, intervals, testing, errors, and power.</p><b>OPEN CHAPTER →</b></a>

<a class="statx-directory-card" href="chapter-05/"><span>CHAPTER 05</span><h3>Comparing Groups</h3><p>t-tests, ANOVA, chi-square tests, correlation, and causal reasoning.</p><b>OPEN CHAPTER →</b></a>

<a class="statx-directory-card" href="chapter-06/"><span>CHAPTER 06</span><h3>Regression and Modeling</h3><p>Linear and logistic regression, interpretation, diagnostics, validation, and overfitting.</p><b>OPEN CHAPTER →</b></a>

<a class="statx-directory-card" href="chapter-07/"><span>CHAPTER 07</span><h3>Modern and Applied Statistics</h3><p>Nonparametric methods, resampling, missing data, Bayesian ideas, and time series.</p><b>OPEN CHAPTER →</b></a>

<a class="statx-directory-card" href="chapter-08/"><span>CHAPTER 08 · OPTIONAL</span><h3>Mathematical Statistics</h3><p>Formal probability, likelihood, estimation theory, bias–variance, and asymptotics.</p><b>OPEN CHAPTER →</b></a>
:::
